_about: Advertised offers read from each business's own site. One row per listing. valid_until is the end date the site states, or empty when it states none (Offers\sweep removes a row the day after it ends; re-check undated rows monthly). Set removed:true to clear a row. Applied by tools/apply-offers.php.

offers.title: Three floats for $177 for first-timers
offers.details: Introductory float package: three one-hour floats for $177 ($59 each) at Beyond Rest East Perth. First-time floaters, one per person, non-transferable. Buy and book online.

offers.title: 10-Day Recovery Experience for $79, first visit
offers.details: Ten days of access to every modality at Recovery Lab Jolimont (private infrared sauna, ice baths, NuCalm, compression lounge, Compex) for $79. First-time guests only, one per person.

offers.title: October special: buy one 60-minute float, get one free
offers.details: Salt Float Studio, South Perth, is running buy-one-get-one-free in October on 60-minute floats ($85), 45-minute sauna, 20-minute red light and compression sessions. Book through the links on the studio's site.

offers.title: Buy 3 sauna sessions, get your 4th free
offers.details: Pay for three 60-minute sauna and cold plunge sessions at Melt Subiaco and the fourth is free. Advertised as a limited-time offer with no end date given; buy through the offer page.

offers.title: 7-day unlimited Reclab pass for $99
offers.details: Seven consecutive days of unlimited access to Reclab's hot and cold plunge pools, steam room, sauna and compression boots for $99 (a single casual session is $39.50). Claim via the special offers page.

offers.title: Buy 6 remedial massages, get a 7th free
offers.details: Prepaid packs at Fremantle Remedial Massage Clinic: six 60-minute massages plus one free for $780 (save $130); 30, 45 and 90-minute packs too. Buy at the clinic; valid 12 months from purchase.

offers.title: Early bird: $10 off massages of an hour or more
offers.details: Book any massage of 60 minutes or longer starting between 8am and 2pm at Royal Silk Rockingham and pay $10 less. Conditions apply; call the clinic to confirm. Public-holiday surcharge applies.

offers.title: 10% off your first appointment booked online
offers.details: New clients save 10% on their first visit to Modern Day Spa, Nedlands, by booking online and entering code BOOKONLINE10 at checkout. Applies to massage, facial and body treatments.

offers.title: Spring Refresh: 90-minute massage package $120
offers.details: Footbath, 15 minutes of dry body brushing, a 60-minute full-body massage and a 15-minute head massage for $120 at Holiday Massage & Spa, Joondalup. Not combinable with other offers.

offers.title: Weekday Surprise Package $119, normally $213
offers.details: A 25-minute body scrub, 15-minute jasmine and coconut body mask, foot reflexology machine session, snacks and a glass of wine in the lounge for $119. Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm; not valid with other discounts.

offers.title: 14 days of unlimited hot yoga and Pilates for $39
offers.details: First-time visitors to The Yoga Garage, Scarborough, get 14 consecutive days of unlimited Hot Vinyasa, Bikram, Yin and Hot Core Pilates for $39. Perth residents only; buy online and arrive 15 minutes early.

offers.title: 21 days of unlimited yoga for $59, buddy pass included
offers.details: New students get 21 days of unlimited classes at both the Cottesloe and Swanbourne studios for $59, props provided, plus one guest pass to bring a friend. Once per person; the 21 days start at your first class.

offers.title: 14 days of unlimited classes for $39
offers.details: New students get 14 days of unlimited Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Iyengar and Yin classes at Yogahub, Mount Hawthorn, for $39. One purchase per person; no suspensions; excludes courses, workshops and events.

offers.title: 25 days of unlimited hot yoga for $49
offers.details: First-timers to Hot For Yoga, Jandakot, get 25 days of unlimited hot yoga for $49, mat and towel hire included. Book online or turn up 15 minutes before your first class.

offers.title: 30 days of unlimited classes for $59, new students
offers.details: New students get 30 days of unlimited drop-in classes (Vinyasa Slow Flow, Yin, Yin/Yang, Gentle, Restore & Relax) at Yoga Corner, Duncraig, for $59. Buy through the new-students page; courses are separate.

offers.title: 2 weeks unlimited classes + body scan for $49
offers.details: New members get two weeks of unlimited boxing and fitness classes at Competitive Boxing & Fitness, Malaga, plus an Evolt 360 body scan, for $49. New members only, no previous trial; limited time, no end date given.

offers.title: 14 days unlimited reformer Pilates for $69
offers.details: New members get 14 days of unlimited reformer classes (Classic, Powerhouse, Sweat and Burn, Mums and Bubs) at Element Pilates, Victoria Park, for $69. The 14 days run from your first class.

offers.title: New clients: 4 reformer classes for $49
offers.details: New clients get four reformer Pilates classes for $49 at Proactive Pilates, Scarborough (Horizon Building, 18 Brighton Rd). Buy through the booking link on the studio's homepage. New clients only.

offers.title: STRONG Experience: 10 days unlimited for $29.50
offers.details: The STRONG Experience intro pass gives unlimited reformer-based sessions for 10 days at STRONG Pilates Rockingham for $29.50, advertised as half price. Buy via the booking section of the location page.

offers.title: New students: 2 weeks unlimited classes for $95
offers.details: New students get 14 days of unlimited beginner-friendly pole, flexibility and conditioning classes at Flying High Aerial Arts, Malaga, for $95. Once per new student; buy through the studio's booking link.

offers.title: Lash Focus package $135 (RRP $169) until end of October
offers.details: Lash lift, lash tint, hydrating eye mask, head massage, aftercare serum and a reusable lash brush for $135 (RRP $169) at Skin Wellness Clinic, Northbridge. The clinic's Aug to Oct 2026 quarterly special.

offers.title: Book The Sculpt in October, your second is $220
offers.details: Book The Sculpt 75-minute facial ($260) at Cult Cosmetica, Inglewood, in October 2026 and a second Sculpt within six weeks is $220. From Tuesday 6 October; one second visit per client; not with other promotions.

offers.title: 20% off the Spring Glow Spa Package, code GLOW20
offers.details: The 75-minute Spring Glow Spa Package (Relax Massage, Organic Express Facial, Hyaluronic Eye Mask) is 20% off with code GLOW20 online or in-spa. Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays, until 30 November 2026.

offers.title: Spring skin needling facial $249, was $378
offers.details: A 50-minute Spring Signature Facial with full-face skin needling, deep cleanse, hydrating sheet mask with hand and arm massage and booster serum for $249 (usually $378). Bundle of three $597. Limited bundles.

offers.title: First visit: spray tan + 20-minute LED session $50
offers.details: New visitors to REDA & CO, Claremont, get a spray tan plus a 20-minute LED light session for $50 on their first visit. Reserve online through the studio's booking page.
